slope.name: slope
slope.algorithm: Horn 3x3 weighted finite-difference gradient; arctangent of gradient magnitude
slope.edge_policy: Outermost row/column is NoData because the full 3x3 stencil is unavailable.
slope.nodata_policy: Output is NoData unless the center and all nine cells in the 3x3 stencil are valid.
slope.aggregation: Pointwise gradient; degrees from the metric rise/run magnitude.

local_relief.name: local_relief
local_relief.algorithm: Local relief = maximum elevation - minimum elevation
local_relief.edge_policy: Window is centered; beyond-raster cells count as missing; insufficient windows are NoData.
local_relief.nodata_policy: Output requires a valid center and at least the configured fraction of cells in the full rectangular neighborhood; NoData and beyond-raster cells count as missing.
local_relief.aggregation: Maximum minus minimum of available neighborhood elevations.

terrain_roughness.name: terrain_roughness
terrain_roughness.algorithm: Elevation standard deviation (population, ddof=0); not vector ruggedness
terrain_roughness.edge_policy: Window is centered; beyond-raster cells count as missing; insufficient windows are NoData.
terrain_roughness.nodata_policy: Output requires a valid center and at least the configured fraction of cells in the full rectangular neighborhood; NoData and beyond-raster cells count as missing.
terrain_roughness.aggregation: Population standard deviation of available neighborhood elevations.

profile_curvature.name: profile_curvature
profile_curvature.algorithm: Directional second derivative along the steepest-slope direction; convex negative
profile_curvature.edge_policy: Outermost row/column is NoData; zero-gradient non-flat critical points are undefined.
profile_curvature.nodata_policy: Output is NoData unless the center and all nine cells in the 3x3 stencil are valid. Non-flat zero-gradient points are NoData.
profile_curvature.aggregation: Derivative curvature in the steepest-slope direction.

plan_curvature.name: plan_curvature
plan_curvature.algorithm: Directional second derivative across the steepest-slope direction; convex positive
plan_curvature.edge_policy: Outermost row/column is NoData; zero-gradient non-flat critical points are undefined.
plan_curvature.nodata_policy: Output is NoData unless the center and all nine cells in the 3x3 stencil are valid. Non-flat zero-gradient points are NoData.
plan_curvature.aggregation: Derivative curvature perpendicular to steepest slope; convex is positive.

topographic_position_index.name: topographic_position_index
topographic_position_index.algorithm: Center elevation minus arithmetic mean of the focal neighborhood, including center
topographic_position_index.edge_policy: Window is centered; beyond-raster cells count as missing; insufficient windows are NoData.
topographic_position_index.nodata_policy: Output requires a valid center and at least the configured fraction of cells in the full rectangular neighborhood; NoData and beyond-raster cells count as missing.
topographic_position_index.aggregation: Positive is locally high, negative locally low, relative to the selected neighborhood.

landform_morphology.name: landform_morphology
landform_morphology.algorithm: Single-scale relative-position classes from TPI divided by the raster-wide TPI population standard deviation
landform_morphology.edge_policy: Inherits TPI edges and NoData; classes describe relative position only.
landform_morphology.nodata_policy: Output requires a valid center and at least the configured fraction of cells in the full rectangular neighborhood; NoData and beyond-raster cells count as missing.
landform_morphology.aggregation: -1=relative low; 0=near local mean; 1=relative high; not geology or material.
